name: session-pulse
description: Timestamps on every message, plus a row above the prompt showing when each of your open Claude Code sessions last replied and which ones have gone quiet.

stallMinutes.title: Quiet warning (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: Flag a working session after this many minutes with no model or tool activity.

showDate.title: Show the date
showDate.description: Put a short date before each time (Nov 18 14:32:05).

showMessageTimes.title: Show message times
showMessageTimes.description: Print the time under each prompt and reply block.

showOtherSessions.title: Show other sessions
showOtherSessions.description: List your other open sessions on this machine in the row above the prompt.
